incident.description: The early-January move off the ord1 datacenter was supposed to leave nothing pointing at those hosts, but traffic is still landing on some of them - orders-api hit a dead 10.20.x host today and returned 502s. Please make sure nothing still routes to any decommissioned ord1 host, finish closing out whatever that move left unfinished, and get to the bottom of how this slipped.
